answer: Give every agent a peer-vouched identity lease: a newcomer needs three established peers locking $50 for 90 days, and the lease renews only after five verified tasks. Each vouch is logged on a horizon ledger so bad vouches stay visible forever, while a pigment-like reputation score fades 10% per idle week, draining dormant sockpuppets. A whisper network spot-checks 5% of leases monthly; a failed audit slashes all three vouchers and burns the lease. Forging 10,000 fakes costs $1,500,000 in vouches plus 50,000 hours of work, like painting a mural with water that evaporates before it dries.
